scope: Marketing reference library; GrantPlan applications are hypotheses unless explicitly observed

sources.title: SEO Starter Guide
claims: Google does not use meta keywords for ranking.
Helpful titles, content and discoverable links matter; impact can take weeks or longer.

sources.title: Creating helpful, reliable, people-first content
claims: Assess original value and usefulness to readers.
Explain authorship and relevant creation context.

sources.title: Spam policies
claims: Doorway pages, keyword stuffing and manipulative link practices violate policy.
Paid links need appropriate qualification.

sources.title: AI features and your website
claims: No special AI file or schema is required for Google AI features.
Eligibility does not guarantee inclusion.

sources.title: URL builders: collect campaign data
claims: Campaign parameters identify referral campaign sources.
Use a consistent source, medium and campaign naming convention.

sources.title: Lead acquisition report
claims: Recommended lead events populate lead acquisition metrics.
generate_lead, qualify_lead and close_convert_lead represent different stages.

sources.title: Avoid sending PII
claims: Do not send information Google could recognize as personally identifiable.
Check URLs and user input for accidental disclosure.

sources.title: Filter out internal traffic
claims: Testing identifies matches without activating exclusion.
An active filter permanently changes incoming data; validate first.

sources.title: Search and discovery tips: Shorts
claims: Shorts discovery depends on viewer personalization and performance.
No particular format guarantees recommendation.

sources.title: Content tab analytics tips: Shorts
claims: Shown in feed and chose to view help diagnose exposure and swipes.
Compare similar formats and inspect traffic sources.

sources.title: Sharing links with your audiences
claims: Shorts description and comment URLs are non-clickable.
Channel profile links can be clickable.

sources.title: Get started creating YouTube Shorts
claims: Since 2025-03-31 Shorts views include starts and replays without a minimum watch duration.
Engaged views remain a separate analytics metric.

sources.title: Add tags to your videos
claims: Title, thumbnail and description are more important than tags.
Tags mainly help with common misspellings; excessive description tags breach policy.

sources.title: Destination requirements
claims: Landing pages must function and offer original value.
Pages mainly showing ads or solely forwarding users can be disapproved.

sources.title: Abusing the ad network
claims: Ad components must not evade review or enforcement.
Circumventing advertising systems is prohibited.

sources.title: About invalid traffic
claims: Recognized invalid interactions are filtered from campaign metrics and billing under the described rules.
Lead quality after the ad click still needs advertiser assessment.

sources.title: Secrets you can learn from your customers
claims: Direct conversations with early customers can reveal unmet needs and context.

sources.title: Inbound Sales Certification
claims: The public course offers identify, connect, explore and advise stages.
The course is advertised as free; its method is training, not evidence of a specific uplift.

retrieval_notes: web_document means document text was obtained through the web tool; it does not mean a course was completed.
official_search_text means primary-source indexed text was inspected; current live page content was not independently confirmed.
An older YC How to Talk to Users URL returned 404 and was excluded. A separate Google Ads circumventing-systems fetch failed; conclusions use the accessible parent policy instead.
An AdSense invalid-traffic recheck reached a Google access challenge. It was not bypassed; the source was replaced with the accessible Google Ads invalid-traffic documentation.
